pages.title: Home
pages.description: A small bakery known for sourdough baked before dawn.

sections.heading: Baked before dawn
sections.body:
Golden Crumb is known for one thing above all: sourdough baked before dawn, so the first loaves are ready when the door opens.

Come by, have a look, and take one home.
